handbook.title: NCEES FE Reference Handbook
handbook.note: Page ranges follow your copy, edition 10.0.1. NCEES has issued newer editions since, so download the current one from your MyNCEES account and expect pages to shift.

sections.title: Mechanics of Materials
sections.notes: Also holds beam deflection formulas and column buckling.

sections.title: Fluid Mechanics
sections.notes: Also holds pump and pipe flow formulas used in water resources.

sections.title: Civil Engineering
sections.notes: The longest section for this exam: geotechnical, structural, hydrology and hydraulics, transportation, surveying and construction.

sections.title: Environmental Engineering
sections.notes: Water and wastewater treatment, water quality and testing.

sources.title: NCEES FE Reference Handbook 10.0.1
sources.use: The only reference allowed in the exam. Practise finding formulas in it.

sources.title: Lindeburg FE Civil Review Manual (2018), file 1 of 3
sources.use: Reading for math, statistics, fluid mechanics, hydraulics, hydrology and environmental.
sources.note: Written for the pre-2020 exam specification.

sources.title: Lindeburg FE Civil Review Manual (2018), file 2 of 3
sources.use: Reading for geotechnical, statics, dynamics, mechanics of materials, materials and the start of structural design.

sources.title: Lindeburg FE Civil Review Manual (2018), file 3 of 3
sources.use: Reading for structural steel, transportation, surveying, construction, economics and ethics.
sources.note: Starts at chapter 42. Its Computational Tools topic is no longer on the exam.

sources.title: Lindeburg FE Civil Practice Problems (2018)
sources.use: Extra practice by topic once a topic's questions here run out.

sources.title: GeniePrep FE Civil problems workbook (2025)
sources.use: Worked problems by topic with linked video solutions.

sources.title: GeniePrep FE cheat sheet (2025)
sources.note: Not allowed in the exam. Use the handbook for lookup practice.
